literal_english: The Pokémon League sent someone to return the Griseous Orb. It turns out that the thing I had always considered ill-omened is actually a token for going to another world and summoning a legendary Pokémon. I have heard all about your heroic deeds from League people. I think you are qualified to become a Trainer of a legendary Pokémon. If you need that Griseous Orb deep in the cave, please take it away and use it.
grammar_notes: 派人 is unspecified agent number. 把…送回来了 is a completed return. 原来…竟然 marks overturned belief. 去另一个世界召唤 is a serial-purpose relation, not merely possessing a key in this world. 传说中精灵 is not explicitly named in this line. 我觉得 qualifies the entitlement judgment. 如果…就 is conditional permission; 那颗 refers to the specified deep-cave Orb.

literal_english: By the way, although you are now the owner, can you pay the Safari Zone admission fee? We too need to rely on this to make a living. Moreover, we still need to research some new equipment to make completing your own Pokédex collection easier. Please enjoy the Safari Zone at your leisure.
grammar_notes: 虽…不过 is concession. 能支付吗 is a courteous payment request with a literal can-pay question, not a statement that ownership is rescinded. 靠这个过日子 means livelihood dependent on the fee/business. 以方便 introduces the purpose of equipment research. 一些 is some, not all; 慢慢 invites unhurried enjoyment.
